defaultValue: Sun and moon are shown at their true altitude angle above the horizon.

items.label: Show time at top
items.description: Moves the time up into the sky.

items.label: High contrast time & date
items.description: Bold outlined text, dark on light by day and light on dark at night, for easier reading. Overrides the auto text color.

items.label: Show moon phase
items.description: Draws the illuminated moon shape instead of a plain disc.

items.label: Run sun & moon ahead of time
Animate wind turbine
items.description: Spins the turbine on every minute change.

items.label: Vivid sky colors
items.description: Boosts saturation for daytime and twilight sky — deeper blues, stronger oranges. Night stays unchanged.

items.label: Weather
items.description: Clouds grey the sky and the wind drives the turbine. With the forecast, clouds sit on the sun's path at the hour the sun will reach them; after sunset it shows tomorrow. The hourly view shows the previous, current and next hour side by side, at the top of the sky or below the date if the time is at the top. Sun and moon always stay in front.

options.label: Plus forecast on the sun path
Plus last, current and next hour

items.label: Show high / low temperature
items.description: Shown in the date line, or in its place if the date is off. Needs weather turned on.
